acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:f7225fae-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As the Staff Product Manager, Data Platform at Vanta, you will be responsible for product strategy and direction for Vanta’s data platform. You’ll sit between the core platform and feature teams, driving the roadmap for transforming how we fetch, store, and use data from customers and 3rd parties at scale. This platform directly enables customer and business outcomes, and backs Vanta’s products and experiences. This is a highly impactful, technical role at the center of how Vanta works and meets customer needs at real scale. Vanta manages data from over 16,000 customers and is rapidly scaling daily. You’ll be part of Vanta’s Automation group, which owns how customers discover and connect to other platforms through integrations, use that data to power product experiences and tests, drive customers toward compliance-related security outcomes, and ultimately generate the evidence required for audit. You aren’t building Vanta’s service delivery platform - you’re building the engine that powers compliance and monitoring outcomes. Your team will be Foundations, which has wide scope and depth, and you’ll be the sole PM to support the data platform. What you’ll do as Staff Product Manager, Data Platform at Vanta: - Own the impactful Data Platform roadmap, pairing closely with engineering counterparts to plan durable platform investments that serve our customers and products built on top of customer data - Collaborate closely with other product teams to understand what platform investments they need to be successful, get ahead of their roadmaps, and create a plan that balances short and long term needs to support customer outcomes. - Directly drive the Vanta data platform strategy and support GRC strategies, creating clarity on sequencing and support as you build the platform and empower teams to use it. - Guide the hard tradeoffs between feature development and platform stability, using clarity and empathy to provide clean direction to other teams. - Enable and evangelize for the data platform, working with other teams to help encourage platform contribution and usage - Work directly with customers to understand unique platform requirements and opportunities including shipping features directly to support an outcome. - Look ahead 12-18 months to build a platform that scales with Vanta, including building toward AI native uses and agent operations. - Create and measure key metrics and results for platform investments, and own key outcomes around scalability, feature enablement, and queryability. - Support an existing team of engineers and tech leads focused on the data platform How to be successful in this role: - Have 6+ years supporting platform teams, with a preference for data platforms or data products. You’ve built and scaled data platforms before, and know how to make platform roadmaps successful. - Come having built 0->1 platforms. You’re not just comfortable with mature data platforms, but have experience building new systems over long time horizons with rich communication along the way. - Balance independence and strong communication. You don’t need someone to tell you what to build next, are comfortable learning fast and driving priority within your team, and proactively loop in engineering, other PMs, and your stakeholders before decisions land. - Have strong frameworks to build complex platforms with clear sequencing, goals, and progress tracking. beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:0e.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:0e.description: ABOUT BEACON SOFTWARE Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com is acquiring and operating a portfolio of vertical SaaS companies. Most private equity firms scale by adding people. We are building Beacon to scale by adding software. The thesis is simple: portfolio operations, value creation, and deal sourcing are bottlenecked by human attention, and an agentic operating system can lift that ceiling by an order of magnitude. We are building that system. It has two pieces. A sensing layer is a cross-portfolio data lake on open table formats with a feature store on top that makes the data agent-readable. An action layer runs workflows across three domains: how we run the portfolio, how we grow the portfolio, and how we acquire into it. Underneath both sits a feedback loop that captures every action and outcome with stable identifiers. Beacon has raised $550M+ from investors including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, and the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp. ABOUT THE ROLE Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) are the engineers who go where the work is. You will be embedded with one or two portfolio companies at a time — sitting with the GM, the operators, and the customer success lead — figuring out where the leverage is, and shipping agentic software directly into their operation. The platforms exist. You are the person who turns them into outcomes on a specific business. This is a Palantir-style FDE role applied to private equity operations. You will spend a meaningful fraction of your time on-site or in the portco’s tools, and the rest of your time back at Beacon HQ pulling the patterns you learned back into the platform. The best FDEs at Beacon will not just deliver for the portcos they are deployed at — they will compress what they learned into reusable playbooks that ship to every other portco in the same vertical. This is not a consulting role. We ship software, not slides. The deliverable is a running system. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Embed deeply with portcos. Spend the first few weeks at a new portco understanding the operating model from the inside: what the GM cares about, where revenue actually comes from, where the team’s time goes, where the system is leaking. Earn the trust of the operators before you start changing things. - Find the leverage. Identify the 2–3 workflows where agentic software will meaningfully change the trajectory of the business — churn-save, pricing experiments, lead enrichment, support deflection, AR follow-up, bug-fix PRs, weekly pulse, whatever the specific portco needs. Pick the wedge, not the wish list. - Ship the wedge. Build the integrations, the prompts, the evals, the workflows, and the UI surfaces required to land the first agentic loop at that portco. Use the platforms our core engineering team is building, and extend them when they fall short. - Operate the loop. Stay close to the system after it ships. Watch the outcomes. Tune the prompts. Adjust the autonomy tier as the system earns trust. Hand off cleanly to portfolio ops once the loop is stable. - Compound the learnings. Bring the patterns back to HQ. Codify what worked into playbooks that ship to every other portco in the vertical. The 11th deployment in a home-services SaaS should be 10x faster than the 1st, and that compression is your job as much as the engineers building the platform. - Carry the GM relationship. You are the technical face of Beacon to the portco GM. Build the trust, set the expectations, and make sure the GM sees the system as their leverage — not Beacon’s audit tool. WHO YOU ARE - A strong generalist engineer. You can ship full-stack TypeScript or Python on the backend, React on the frontend, SQL fluently, comfortable in someone else’s codebase within a day. You do not need to be a specialist in any one stack. You need to be the person who can land the whole thing. - Customer-obsessed. jobgether-jobgether:lever:1028704d-7e5e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Underwriter (Homeowners & Condo Insurance) based in the United States. This is a senior underwriting opportunity focused on evaluating complex homeowners and condominium property risks. You’ll apply deep P&C expertise to make thoughtful coverage, eligibility, and pricing decisions that support profitable portfolio growth. You’ll collaborate closely with product, actuarial, claims, legal, data, and technology teams to shape underwriting strategy and improve processes. Serve as a technical resource and mentor for less-experienced underwriters, sharing expertise and providing guidance on complex risks and underwriting decisions. Build productive relationships with internal stakeholders, agents, brokers, business partners, and support teams. Clearly communicate underwriting decisions, requirements, risk considerations, and recommendations to relevant stakeholders. Active Property & Casualty insurance license . Demonstrated experience evaluating and underwriting complex property risks, ideally including homeowners, condominium, personal-lines property, commercial property, or comparable products. Strong knowledge of underwriting principles, risk evaluation, eligibility criteria, coverage considerations, and portfolio performance. Ability to interpret data and analytics and use them to support informed underwriting decisions. Experience working with technology-enabled underwriting environments, such as automated workflows, predictive analytics, AI-assisted insights, digital underwriting platforms, or rules-based decision systems. Effective communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical, business, and insurance functions. Comfortable working independently in a fully virtual office environment. jobgether-jobgether:lever:d06c6df5-9c64-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Power BI Developer based in the United States. This is a senior, client-facing opportunity for a Power BI professional who combines advanced technical expertise with strong data visualization and consulting skills. You will design enterprise-scale analytics solutions that turn complex business questions into clear, actionable insights. The role spans the full BI lifecycle, from discovery and data modeling through dashboard design, deployment, and adoption. You’ll work directly with stakeholders across industries including financial services, retail, CPG, and construction. Beyond development, you’ll shape UX standards, improve data governance, and champion accessible, intuitive analytics experiences. You’ll also mentor other professionals and contribute to reusable frameworks that strengthen delivery capabilities across engagements. Success will come from becoming a trusted advisor who can connect technical decisions with measurable business outcomes. Design, develop, and maintain scalable Power BI solutions , including semantic models, star schemas, composite and tabular models, dashboards, paginated reports, and embedded analytics. Develop advanced DAX measures, time-intelligence calculations, calculation groups, and optimized Power Query (M) transformations while troubleshooting performance using tools such as DAX Studio, Tabular Editor, and Performance Analyzer. Implement Power BI governance and enterprise capabilities, including Row-Level Security, workspace management, deployment pipelines, gateways, dataflows, incremental refresh, naming standards, and semantic model documentation . Create wireframes and intuitive dashboard experiences using strong UX/UI, information design, accessibility, visual hierarchy, data storytelling, and visualization principles . Establish reusable design systems, themes, templates, and component standards to create consistent, high-quality analytics experiences across client engagements. Conduct usability reviews, UAT sessions, office hours, and iterative feedback cycles to improve dashboard effectiveness and drive user adoption.
